total_supply_zero.meaning: gauge _totalSupply equals zero after all staked tokens are withdrawn

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: time passes with no deposits while gauge total supply is zero

notify_reward_called.meaning: distribution contract calls notifyRewardAmount to add new rewards during the empty period

rewards_claimable_after.meaning: reward emissions for the empty period are accrued and remain claimable by users after new deposits and interactions
rewards_claimable_after.checkpoint: after empty period and later deposits

protocol_fund_loss_occurs.meaning: entire epochs of reward emissions become permanently stuck in the contract without recovery
protocol_fund_loss_occurs.checkpoint: after empty period and later deposits

assumptions: Reward tokens are transferred to the gauge contract during the empty period via notifyRewardAmount.
New deposits and user interactions occur after the empty period.
No attacker is required; harm arises from normal withdrawals and reward notifications.

unresolved.description: Report states notifyRewardAmount 'may be called' during the empty period; whether it is actually called is not established.
Exact amounts of stuck reward tokens and precise reward duration beyond 'one week' are not specified.

limitations: Impact is formalized as a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric amount of stuck rewards.
The empty-period scenario is the only subcase established; general low-liquidity gauges are not separately encoded.
